S1037.reason: A permitted assignment puts the investor in the buyer’s shoes, so the investor may obtain specific performance when the owner refuses to convey land.

S0107.reason: Immunity ratione personae belongs only to certain high officials in office and covers both private and official acts.

S0341.reason: Normal adult resting respiration is about 12–20 breaths per minute, and 14–16 is the only range fully inside that band.
